title: Report post
which: Which rule does the post break?

insult.label: Insult
insult.hint: Belittling a person instead of engaging with the issue

misinformation.label: Misinformation, disproved by a source
misinformation.hint: Please give the source in the next step

disagree: Disagree? That is what arguments are for. Disagreement can push a post down, but never remove it.
juryIntro: Case {caseNo}: a randomly drawn jury from your region reviews it anonymously.
how1: Up to seven people are drawn by lot.
how2: They see the post without names, with context and the reported rule.
how3: The majority decides. Both sides learn the result.
